title: ICTs quality and technical efficiency: an empirical analysis
summary: Earlier work on ICTs and technical efficiency relied mainly on quantity-based ICT measures, which have come under severe criticism. This paper shifts the focus to quality-based measures, in this case Internet quality, and finds a positive effect on technical efficiency.
keyFindings: Internet quality has a positive effect on technical efficiency.
The gains are larger in countries with more skilled labour, more cross-border trade, stronger contract enforcement and deeper financial markets.
The marginal effect of ICT quality rises as the number of Internet users grows.
